# Triage Review Comments

Fetches pull request review comments, verifies and triages the feedback, and
reports what needs attention without taking action.

## Install

Install this skill for GitHub Copilot at user scope:

```sh
gh skill install radiantspace/radiantspace triage-review-comments \
  --allow-hidden-dirs \
  --agent github-copilot \
  --scope user
```

Install every skill from this repository:

```sh
gh skill install radiantspace/radiantspace \
  --all \
  --allow-hidden-dirs \
  --agent github-copilot \
  --scope user
```
